decisions.reason: The pipe cleaning box is an unresolved option close to existing fluid-handling capabilities and is cheap to keep while market uncertainty resolves.
Public waste bins are distant from the core but still an unresolved option, so management keeps it despite higher carrying costs from the weaker fit.
Ground sleeves build on existing fabrication skills and remain a low-cost option while demand uncertainty persists.
Cast iron ground sleeves may have higher sourcing costs and overlap with other variants, so the firm keeps a closer watch but maintains the option.
Steel ground sleeves align directly with the firm's steel-processing strengths and are inexpensive to keep as an unresolved option.
